intent_summary: Multi-resolution analysis keeps native finalized subperiod evidence and completed fixed 24-hour aggregates, with a separate marker for the unfinished day.

criteria.criterion: Callers can select sum, mean, or last aggregation for completed and partial periods.
criteria.notes: Parameterized assertions check independently known completed and partial values for all three aggregation choices.

criteria.criterion: Regular timestamped sub-day samples produce distinct native and completed-period analysis views.
criteria.notes: Separate datasets, configurations, and namespaces preserve the two correlated views.

criteria.criterion: A trailing partial aggregate reports observed progress and links its native evidence while remaining outside the completed-period series.
criteria.notes: The marker contains finalized progress, observed aggregate, native evidence references, and an explicit exclusion flag.

criteria.criterion: An explicitly unfinished source sample is excluded from both analysis views.
criteria.notes: Both child datasets use prepared finalized observations; tests verify counts and retention of the excluded original value.

criteria.criterion: A source cadence that does not evenly divide 24 hours is rejected.
criteria.notes: A five-hour cadence raises the specific dividing-cadence error.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
